rules.statement: A Kandyan deed of gift does not necessarily renounce the right to revoke by using the words 'for ever'.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore I do hereby invest the said donees, Wimalahamy, Ram Menika, Mutu Menika, Siyatu Banda, and Punchappuhamy and their heirs, executors, administrators, and assigns with the full power and authority that they be owners from this date and possess the said premises hereby donated and all the right, title, and interest of me the said donor in and to the same for ever without any interruption whatsoever or deal with the same in whatsoever manner they may desire".
